source.extraction: ast.unparse selected original nodes; verified AST equality ignoring location
source.rank_shim: single-process dist.get_rank returns0 for PolicyLoss diagnostic only

signal_receipt.reward_baseline: actual peer response lengths, with step lengths excluding boundary token
signal_receipt.kl_logps: frozen old-policy minus frozen reference log probabilities
signal_receipt.kl_location: subtract beta*kl from baseline-adjusted token reward before reverse cumsum

normalization.all_zero_behavior: block with ValueError; never replace with invented rewards

signal_receipt.loss: Pinned PolicyLoss: response token mean then batch mean, clip 0.2 by default
signal_receipt.micro_loss_scaling: single-response official loss / full SignalBatch batch_size
signal_receipt.processing_device: cpu baseline/KL/returns/norm; PRM transform device explicit above
limits: Step/token alignment must be independently established by the caller.
Boundary masking also suppresses ordinary EOS and the last action of truncated outputs.
No claim that empty PRM scores or nonempty meaningless responses have been fixed.
This is single-device integration of the signal/loss path, not a reproduction of distributed OpenRLHF runtime.

definitions.whitespace_only: raw string is nonempty but strip() is empty
definitions.natural_eos_only: one raw emitted token, original_terminated=True and evidence that token is terminal EOS
definitions.short: raw content token count <=32, includes empty; subtract one only for evidenced original terminal EOS
definitions.no_sep: official alignment has <=1 step; differs from raw double-newline text marker
definitions.no_box: raw text lacks a literal backslash-boxed followed by opening brace; not a verifier reclassification
definitions.truncated: original_terminated=False, including cases where official processing inserts/replaces EOS
definitions.processed_content_tokens: official processed action length minus its terminal EOS; may differ from raw generated content
definitions.missing: unknowns excluded from each rate denominator; zero denominator -> null

task_rewards.meaning: Sum of the supplied task matrix before baseline/KL; P-VR task matrix is structurally zero, not its verifier reward.

advantages.meaning: Normalized advantages supplied to loss; positive mass is sum(max(A_t,0)) over valid tokens. Categories overlap.

sync.method: FP32 CPU merged copies, cast to base dtype, no mutation of actor; reset prefix cache
